newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Bioscience names Robert Kriebel CFO.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Bioscience names Robert Kriebel CFO.

text.p: U.S. Bioscience Inc said on Monday it named Robert Kriebel, 54, as executive vice president and chief financial officer.
Kriebel joined the company in 1991 and was senior vice president of finance and administration, U.S. Bioscience said.
The chief financial officer position had been vacant, a company spokesman said.
Before joining U.S. Bioscience, Kriebel had several management positions, including treasurer, at Rorer Group Inc, now part of Rhone-Poulenc Rorer Inc.
U.S. Bioscience is a pharmaceutical company specializing in the development and commercialization of products for patients with cancer and AIDS.
